sentence_stem: Of all the cities we visited,
full_sentence: Of all the cities we visited, Kraków was the most beautiful.
acceptable_variants: Kraków was the most beautiful city of all.
Kraków was truly the most beautiful.

options.why_wrong: 'More' forms a comparative, but 'of all' requires a superlative comparing the cities as a group.
'Beautiful' is a long adjective, so it does not take an ending; the superlative needs 'the most'.
Long adjectives form the superlative with 'the most', not with the ending '-est'.

grammar_focus: Superlative 'the most + adjective' with long adjectives after 'of all'
explanation: The phrase 'of all' compares one item with a whole group, so the completion needs a superlative. With long adjectives such as 'beautiful', English places 'most' before the adjective instead of adding an ending. Polish speakers usually add a prefix to the adjective to make the superlative, so the English pattern with a separate word may feel unfamiliar.
translation: Ze wszystkich miast, które odwiedziliśmy, Kraków był najpiękniejszy.
